name: Text to Morse
summary: Encode plain text into International Morse code with dots, dashes, and word separators.
description: Type or paste text to get Morse code with spaces between letters and a slash or pipe between words. Supports A–Z, digits, and common punctuation using standard International Morse.

faqs.question: How are words separated?
faqs.answer: Choose a slash (/) or pipe (|) between words. Letters within a word are separated by spaces.

faqs.question: What characters can I encode?
faqs.answer: Letters A–Z, digits 0–9, and punctuation including period, comma, question mark, exclamation, slash, and at-sign.

faqs.question: Can I decode Morse here?
faqs.answer: Use the Morse to Text tool for decoding dot-dash input.
